title: Add harness cases for a decision question at each level
description: Add harness cases for a decision question at Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced, including a close call, two poor options and a one-way door, per the design in opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c, section Changes this needs in plain-english-styles item 6.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Harness cases cover a decision question at Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced
The new cases include a close call, two poor options and a one-way door
The cases are held out of every optimizer split

finalSummary:
Adds three decision-question cases on the reserve split, each naming the five PES-7 checks plus the style checks: reserve-decision-oneway (a one-way door: dropping a table the archive cannot rebuild), reserve-decision-close (a close call with numbers on both sides), reserve-decision-lose-lose (two poor options, with quantities, distinct from reserve-decision-tie whose point is that it has none). Every case runs under all three styles via the matrix, so Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced are covered. Cases go from 15 to 18.

Also carries the three edges the leader flagged, each with the decision it forced, as tests in harness/test/checks.test.mjs:

1. Bare "tell me". Measured: Option C: tell me to add a cache tier read as free text, cPresent true, and a real third option passed the cap. DECISION: the bare "tell me" is dropped from FREE_TEXT_LINE; every remaining phrase asks the reader for their own words (different answer, your own answer, answer differently, tell me another, free text, anything else). The styles own line still matches through "different answer".

2. Unbounded mermaid fence. Measured: prose in a mermaid fence at Beginner scored 1 on code_block_size and was excluded from total_length, so text could leave the word budget by mislabelling itself. DECISION: a fence is exempt only when it OPENS with a Mermaid diagram type (isDiagramFence); a headerless fence is not a diagram and stays counted as code. A fence with the header that is still not valid Mermaid is what diagram_parses rejects. This surfaced a stale fixture in the PES-6 test, whose 30-line fence had no header: fixed to open with flowchart LR.

3. Browser versus terminal parser divergence. Measured: Mermaid own parser accepts quadrantChart (diagram_parses scores 1) while beautiful-mermaid, which draws the terminal art, returns unsupported-type, so the mod falls back to source plus the Open diagram button. Recorded as the concrete case behind PES-7 note that diagram_parses certifies the browser renderer only.

Gates: npm --prefix harness test 262 pass / 0 fail (was 259); node src/cli.mjs audit exit 0, all 12 checks agree; claude plugin test 21/21; claude plugin validate exit 0.
